question_summary: Contractor requests approval to locally shift the layout at Placement Zone 2 to avoid an unforeseen underground obstruction and asks whether review is required before proceeding.
proposed_solution: Shift the layout locally around the obstruction and hold all other elements per plan.
deadline_text: A response next week would still let us stay on track.
routing_rationale: Design direction is needed for a subsurface obstruction impacting site layout; the Civil EOR is responsible for site/earthwork and plan modifications.
